name: Edit Kit front door
summary: Router: checks setup, asks intake, picks one of 11 styles or a special look, then runs director.
tsvg_note: Equivalent: the tsvg skill + tsvg new (template pick) is the TSVG front door.

name: Motion FX library (MotionKit + CreatorFX)
summary: Shared HyperFrames/GSAP effects runtime, scaffolder, word timer and finalize encoder used by reels/youtube/saas.
tsvg_note: TSVG has its own primitives (tweens, keyframes, repeat, data); its effects are rated individually below as fx/*.

name: Motion Theme
summary: Picks palette and font pair from a brand kit, prompt or footage analysis; writes theme.json.
tsvg_note: TSVG has themes as an option; no footage colour analysis (would be a pre-step).

name: Sound Design
summary: SFX on impact frames at -17 dB, soft music bed, Kokoro/ElevenLabs voiceover, -14 LUFS mix.
tsvg_note: TSVG already has narration per language, music and sfx on buses with mixes; loudness targets would be set per bus.

name: Edit QA
summary: Format, loudness, SFX sync and frame-by-frame visual checklist before delivery.
tsvg_note: TSVG equivalent: tsvg check (no encode, so format/keyframe checks are moot; loudness/sync checks partly).

name: Motion Doctrine (seam gate)
summary: Motion law: vector ledger, carriers, causal motion, no idle wobble, stillness before climax, Seam Gate verifier.
tsvg_note: Doctrine applies as authoring guidance to TSVG scenes; no TSVG seam verifier yet.

name: Edit Director (raw clip / script / idea to finished edit)
summary: Intake, raw cut, words, theme, storyboard, build, sound and QA for any of 11 styles.
tsvg_note: Script/idea styles (SaaS, motion graphics, finance) work; raw-clip talking-head edits need a video node.
